summary: Russian forces conducted strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure including ports and logistics centers, while Ukrainian forces reported drone attacks near Sumy and ZAEK. Wildberries logistics centers in Russian territory were targeted by Ukrainian drones, causing casualties. Ukrainian Air Force claimed 90% drone interception rate over 2022-2026 period.
key_points: Ukrainian forces reported drone attacks near the third energy block of ZAEK reactor (Source: @tass_agency/388368).
Russian forces struck Ukrainian port infrastructure and ships used for supply (Source: @tass_agency/388368).
Drone exploded at enterprise in Yasnye Zoryi, Belgorod region, causing casualties (Source: @tass_agency/388339).
Ukrainian drone attacked private sector in Zaporizhzhia, killing one person (Source: @UkraineNow/83121).
Wildberries logistics centers in Moscow, Tambov, Krasnodar, and other regions targeted by Ukrainian drones (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32110).
Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian territory focused on logistics, fuel infrastructure, and warehouses (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32110).
Ukrainian Air Force reported over 445,000 air targets destroyed including 65,618 Shahed-type drones (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69625).
Russian drone attacks on Ukrainian infrastructure continued daily (Source: @tass_agency/388357).

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces are escalating strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure, including ports and energy facilities, which could disrupt logistics and energy supply. Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian territory target critical logistics nodes, potentially degrading Russian military capabilities. The ongoing drone warfare highlights both sides' reliance on asymmetric tactics to offset conventional disadvantages.
sections.regional_response: European concerns about post-Macron support for Ukraine were noted, with fears of leadership gaps in the 'Coalition of the Willing' (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32123). Wildberries' compensation for drone attack casualties reflects Russian public and economic impact. Port shutdowns in Odessa due to drone attacks have reduced grain exports by approximately one-third (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32110).
sections.intelligence_notes: Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian logistics infrastructure indicate a strategy to degrade supply lines. Russian advances in eastern Ukraine, particularly towards Druzhkovka, suggest a focus on consolidating gains. The high interception rate of Ukrainian drones by their own air defenses demonstrates effective defensive capabilities despite resource constraints.
